# Dataplugs

> > Dataplugs provides enterprise-grade dedicated server hosting, colocation, and BGP network services with optimized connectivity to China via CN2 GIA, China Telecom, China Unicom, and China Mobile networks.

Dataplugs specializes in high-performance hosting infrastructure with direct connectivity to Mainland China markets including Hong Kong, Guangzhou, Shanghai, and Beijing. The company offers Tier-1 ISP peering, enterprise hardware from Dell, Supermicro, and Nvidia, with Tier-3 datacenter facilities and DDoS protection.

## Key Topics

- BGP Network Services
- CN2 GIA (China Telecom Next Generation Network)
- China Connectivity (Unicom, Mobile, Telecom)
- Dedicated Server Hosting
- Colocation Services
- Hong Kong & Mainland China Routes
- Tier-1 ISP Peering
- Enterprise Hardware (Dell, Supermicro, Nvidia)
- SSD Hosting Solutions
- DDoS Protection
- Tier-3 Datacenter Infrastructure
- Guangzhou, Shanghai, Beijing Network Points
- Web Hosting Services
- Asia-Pacific Network Optimization
